title: Task list
desc: The whole team's to-do list, the first screen after signing in. Add a task in one line, tick it off when it is done, show only what is still open. Clickable like the real thing.

scenarios.title: A normal day
scenarios.desc: Six tasks: four still open (one is late, one is due today, one has nobody on it yet) and two done, struck through at the bottom.

scenarios.title: No tasks yet
scenarios.desc: A new team on its first day: the list is replaced by a short invitation to add the first task, and there are no filters yet.

scenarios.title: A busy week
scenarios.desc: Thirty-six tasks, more than fit on one screen: the page scrolls, nothing is cut off and there is no button to load more.
